address: 455 rue de la Haute-Meilleraie, Varades, 44370, France
bio: Surrounded by rose bushes, this restaurant, which has stood on the banks of the Loire since 1938, affords a stunning view of the river and the abbey church of St-Florent-le-Vieil. In a tasteful contemporary interior, the chef crafts a traditional lineup drawing on regional fare (hake, pollock, farm-reared lamb, calf sweetbreads) flanked by classic sauces (beurre blanc, shellfish jus, wine sauce)....
